title: Spicy Teriyaki Baked Salmon
description: A fusion of Japanese flavors with an American twist, this spicy teriyaki baked salmon is a unique dish that's sure to impress. Pair it with a side of steamed vegetables for a well-rounded meal.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Cherry or grape tomatoes work well

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Place the salmon fillet on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the salmon.
In a small bowl, mix together the spicy teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Brush the sauce mixture over the salmon.
Sprinkle the breadcrumbs over the top of the salmon.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
